name: Personal Hygiene
overview: Scripture addresses personal hygiene not only in physical terms, such as cleanliness laws concerning leprosy and camp sanitation in Leviticus and Deuteronomy, but also spiritually, emphasizing the presentation of our bodies as holy and acceptable sacrifices to God (Romans 12:1). While certain practices were mandated for health and purity, the New Testament reminds believers that nothing is inherently unclean except what one personally regards as such (Romans 14:14), highlighting a balance between outward cleanliness and inward holiness.
